name: remotedesk
description: Cross-OS remote desktop: signaling server, browser viewer, and Electron host/viewer app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,viewer -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @remotedesk/server" "npm run dev -w @remotedesk/viewer"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @remotedesk/viewer && npm run build -w @remotedesk/server && npm run build -w @remotedesk/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @remotedesk/desktop
